National Expressway Development Authority 
 GOVERNMENT CLIENT · Jharkhand · IN
 
 REFERENCE LETTER 
 
 To Whomsoever It May Concern 
 
 Ref: REF/54/49 Date: 31 Mar 2026
 
 To Whomsoever It May Concern, 
 This letter is issued at the request of National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. to confirm that the said agency has executed work for this
 organisation as detailed below and that their performance has been found satisfactory.
 
 1. PROJECT DETAILS 
 
 Project Name Rigid Pavement - Jharkhand Pkg-56 
 
 Scope of Work Roads Highways works for National Expressway Development Authority completed 2017.
 
 Nature of Work Roads Highways 
 Contract Value Rs. 2115.00 Lakh 
 
 Date of Completion 2017-03-06 
 
 Contractor's Role Prime 
 
 2. PERFORMANCE ASSESSMENT 
 
 Throughout the engagement the agency's conduct was cooperative, with weekly progress reporting maintained without prompting, and .
 On that basis the agency may be invited for future tenders in this category.
 
 Criterion Rating Observation 
 
 Adherence to Schedule Excellent Project delivered within contractual timeline
 Quality of Work Excellent Workmanship meets or exceeds specifications 
 
 Safety Record Good BOCW Act compliance maintained throughout 
 
 Responsiveness Excellent Prompt resolution of site issues and RFIs 
 Financial Integrity Good Billing was accurate and supported by records
 
 3. RECOMMENDATION 
 
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. completed the engagement within the sanctioned time and cost, and their conduct on site was
 professional throughout. We would consider them for similar works. 
 
 We have no hesitation in recommending National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for similar assignments in the future. This reference is valid
 for a period of High from the date of this letter. 
 
 4. VERIFICATION 
 For any verification or further information, please contact the undersigned at +91-9830000000 or ee@dept.gov.in. This letter is issued upon specific request of the
 contractor and does not constitute any commitment or guarantee for future engagements.
